notes: Small additive linked-impact build. When a replacement RA or COSHH RA is detected by Document Change Impact, the same area now gives one-click access to every explicitly linked SSW and Toolbox Talk, including TBTs linked through the affected SSW. Managers can review/keep an item as-is and create a permanent audit record, or mark it for modification. SSW modification opens the existing replacement-version upload directly. Toolbox Talk modification creates a pending replacement TBT while the current approved TBT remains in use; when the replacement is approved, the existing approval workflow archives the old TBT and transfers the audience/assignments. A 'review all unchanged' shortcut is included for genuinely minor changes. Supabase migration linked_impact_reviews_v21057 applied. This phase does not yet add in-app editing of creator-generated SSW/TBT content, refresher-method controls or ad-hoc retraining; those remain separate small builds. Includes v2.10.56 and earlier fixes.
